answer: Each identity posts a delivery commitment: one parcel due by close, backed by a 60-credit bond in an onyx registry. Its voyage: submission, checkpoint, delivery, each signed by its own key. A zephyr audit replays sampled parcels; undelivered, copied, or rented ones burn the bond. Each fake costs 45 credits of work plus 60 locked: 1,000 fakes burn 45,000, lock 60,000, against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents deliver once, pay 45, reclaim the bond.
